def field_locations(obj,prefix="root"):
 result=[]
 if isinstance(obj,dict):
  for k,v in obj.items():
   if k in ("fields","columns") and isinstance(v,list) and all(isinstance(z,str) for z in v):
    result.append({"location":prefix+"."+k,"fields":v})
   elif k not in ("items","rows","records"):
    result.extend(field_locations(v,prefix+"."+k))
 return result

 a=rec["response_artifact"]; f=root/a["path"]
 raw=json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
 fields=field_locations(raw)
 records.append({"path":a["path"],"sha256":hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"matches_original_receipt_hash":hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==a["sha256"],"root_keys":list(raw) if isinstance(raw,dict) else "列表","actual_response_field_schemas":fields,"actual_amount_column_present":any("amount" in v["fields"] for v in fields),"values_not_output":True})

assert not any(r["actual_amount_column_present"] for r in records)
